name: methodic
description: Methodic platform plugins for Claude Code — skills + a bundled MCP server (call Chronicle directly, no SDK install) for working with Chronicle experiments.

plugins.name: chronicle
plugins.description: Skills that help your agent track research hypotheses and experimental results on the Chronicle platform, with role-filtered search over past experimental results and uploaded research documents — research surveys, hypothesis-driven experiment + variation generation, repo/arxiv import as a provisioned experiment, history/lineage search, prep/fork variations, dataset upload, topic collections + keyword tags, report write-ups, cross-variation distillation, lifecycle (delete open drafts, retract committed work, purge orphaned assets, move into an org), status.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research-workflow skills that compose the chronicle plugin's mechanics into multi-step practices, with the researcher as the approval gate: synthesis (ground in the experiment record + literature, then propose and queue what to try next with pre-registered hypotheses), evaluate-results (judge runs and variations against what they pre-registered; optionally persist findings, lessons, and review-gated reports), literature-review (survey the internal corpus + external literature, register and cite what matters), and paper-authoring (author a LaTeX paper locally and attach it so Chronicle compiles and records it). Requires the chronicle plugin.
